name: Integrated CPU-GPU (shared LPDDR5, unified memory)
provenance: H1 service model. Aggregate bandwidth = A-007 swept shared-memory range; effective = aggregate x contention (compute and transfer share the bus). Latency + copy engines registered/swept. H2-UPGRADE: the contention factors below are now cross-checked against DRAM-timing-measured values (Ramulator2 LPDDR5-6400, data/canonical/moe_routing_v1/mem_timing.json): streaming-only ~0.93 (better than guessed 0.8); moderate compute contention ~0.30 (worse than guessed 0.6, row-thrashing). The SW-vs-HW decision does not flip under either (scripts/w3_mem_recheck.py).
note: effective bandwidth = aggregate * contention; prefetch_bw_fraction = contention (transfers overlap compute only using the spare fraction).
